title: Where each log line ran
prompt: The on-call dashboard needs to know where each log line came from. Write `solve(application_logs)` so it returns every line with its region, host and how many attributes it carries.
rules: `region` and `host` are the values stored under those keys in `attributes`, as text. A line without the key has a missing value.
`entries` is the number of keys in `attributes`: 0 for an empty map, missing when there is no map at all.
Return `log_id`, `service`, `region`, `host` and `entries`, one row per log line.
hints: `application_logs.printSchema()` shows `attributes` as a map of text to text.
Read a key with `F.col("attributes")["region"]` and name it with `.alias`.
`F.size("attributes")` counts the entries of a map.
starter:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F


def solve(application_logs):
    # Every log line with region, host and entries.
    return application_logs
